blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Several local government units in Metro Cebu suspended in-person classes on Monday, Oct. 12, 2026, due to poor air quality. The suspensions came after Metro Cebu’s air quality index (AQI) reached 180 at 4 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 11, according to the Environmental Management Bureau Region VII (EMB-7). Earlier readings showed an AQI of 155 at 11 a.m. and 152 at 7 a.m. The bureau classified all three readings as “very unhealthy” levels of fine particulate matter, or PM2.5.
